title: Machine representation relation
statement: Let $Z$ be a size specification of word width $W$, let $\sigma$ be a state with local values $\sigma_{\mathrm{loc}}(x)$ and memory values $\sigma_{\mathrm{mem}}(a)$, let $q$ be a natural number, and let $m$ assign a $W$-bit word to each integer address. The relation holds when $m$ maps the distinguished codes for $1$, $0$, and $-1$ to those respective words; maps each pool code for $n\le d$ to the word for $n$; maps the frame-pointer code to the word for stack position $c_{\mathrm{Stack}}(q)$; maps each local stack position $c_{\mathrm{Stack}}(q+x)$, for $x<F$, to the word for $\sigma_{\mathrm{loc}}(x)$; and maps every address $a<S$ to the word for $\sigma_{\mathrm{mem}}(a)$.
hypotheses_covered: $Z$ is a size specification of word width $W$
